name: allinbox
description: All your inboxes, one query. Search every email account at once; read-only, cannot send.
long_description:
allinbox lets Claude search Gmail, Google Workspace, iCloud, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP account in a single call, merged and deduplicated, with quotes, signatures and HTML stripped.

**Before installing**, add your accounts once in a terminal with `npx allinbox` (requires Node.js 20.12+). The guided setup stores app passwords in your OS keychain; this extension never sees them.

Mailboxes are opened read-only and there is no sending code. Drafts are opt-in and limited to recipients you allow.
